message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend).  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the actual date(s) that make up the long weekend, and a short note on any “observed” dates.

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|---------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 (Sun) – Jan 2 (Mon)** | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, NB, MB, PEI) | **Feb 18 (Sat) – Feb 20 (Mon)** | Family Day is on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 9 (Sun)** | Good Friday is on Friday, Apr 7. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 (Sat) – May 22 (Mon)** | Victoria Day is on Monday, May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 (Sat) – Jul 3 (Mon)** | Canada Day falls on Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 (Sat) – Sep 4 (Mon)** | Labour Day is on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 (Sat) – Oct 9 (Mon)** | Thanksgiving is on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day | **Nov 9 (Sat) – Nov 11 (Mon)** | Remembrance Day is on Monday, Nov 11. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 (Sat) – Dec 25 (Mon)** | Christmas Day is on Monday, Dec 25. |

### Quick Reference (by month)

- **January** – New Year’s (Jan 1–2)  
- **February** – Family Day (Feb 18–20)  
- **April** – Good Friday (Apr 7–9)  
- **May** – Victoria Day (May 20–22)  
- **July** – Canada Day (Jul 1–3)  
- **September** – Labour Day (Sep 2–4)  
- **October** – Thanksgiving (Oct 7–9)  
- **November** – Remembrance Day (Nov 9–11)  
- **December** – Christmas (Dec 23–25)

> **Note:**  
> - **Boxing Day** falls on Tuesday, Dec 26, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in PEI, etc.) that may also create long weekends locally. If you need province‑specific data, let me know!  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you’d like the data in JSON or CSV format, just ask!
